name: ng-tab-bar
title: Tab Bar (Angular)
description: Bottom tab bar for phone screens - TabBar, TabBarItem (gr-tab-bar, gr-tab-bar-item, a[gr-tab-bar-item]). Three looks on one API: material, ios and floating. Badges, hide on scroll, safe-area aware. Mirrors React TabBar from @gremorie/rx-navigation.

usage.whenNotToUse: TBD - document when to reach for something else.
